title: The Migration From July to October
excerpt: From July to October the migration is in the northern Serengeti and the Masai Mara, with dramatic river crossings. What to know.
body:
July to October is the most famous period of the migration. The herds have reached the northern Serengeti and the Masai Mara.

## River crossings

The herds cross the Mara River, often several times. See [river crossings](/blog/great-migration-river-crossings/).

## Where to go

- Northern Serengeti around Kogatende and Lamai.
- The Masai Mara in Kenya.
- See [where to stay for the migration](/blog/migration-camps-where-to-stay/).

## Weather

Dry season. Sunny days, cool mornings and evenings.

## Busy

This is high season. Book early, sometimes a year ahead for popular camps.

## Elsewhere

Tarangire is at its best in this period, and Kilimanjaro has its main climbing season.

[Plan your migration safari](/travel-proposal/).
